title: Liver_H2O_1
characteristics_ch1: tissue: Liver | strain: ICR | Sex: Male | genotype: WT | treatment: H2O
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted from the livers of mice using RNA isolation kit (#R6934–01, Omega Bio-Tek, USA) according to the manufacturer's instructions | TOYOBO ReverTra Ace qPCR RT kit was utilized for reverse transcription
data_processing: Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between the H2O and MPs groups were analyzed using linear models for the microarray data (limma) package in R. | The heatmap was drawn by the R package pheatmap. | The shared DEGs between each MPs group and the H2O group were identified by drawing a Venn diagram. | Gene ontology (GO, http://www.geneontology.org/) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG, https://www.kegg.jp/) pathway enrichment analyses of DEGs were performed by using DAVID online tools (https://david.ncifcrf.gov/). | The protein‒protein interaction (PPI) network was predicted using the STRING database (http://string-db.org, version 11.5) | Assembly: NCBI (GCF_000001635.26_GRCm38.p6) | Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text file includes raw expression of genes for each sample | Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text file includes raw expression of RNA for each sample
